intent.proves: At least one visible paragraph on a non-deleted page renders an app.

bindings.reason: search_paragraphs requires a module system name or scope; Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph x JOIN Page p ON p.PageId = x.ParagraphPageId WHERE x.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND x.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND p.PageDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(x.ParagraphModuleSystemName, N'') <> N''
